content: {"episode_id":"ep-05096","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"Atlas Mutual denied CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) under CO-50 as not medically necessary, and we respectfully appeal that determination. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). As stated in the order, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. We ask that the denial be overturned and the outstanding balance of 679.19 be reprocessed for payment."}
